statement:
∀ (θ : ℝ) (n T : ℕ), ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity θ ≤ ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.fieldSize (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension θ) n →
    ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.SamplerTables.entropy (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension θ) n (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity θ) (Nat.log 2 (n / ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity θ)) ≤ T →
    ∀ G : ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.Generator (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.rowCount (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension θ) n) n,
      ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.uniformProb (fun ω : Fin T → Bool => ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.binarySamplerFromInput (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension θ) n (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity θ)
        (Nat.log 2 (n / ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.arity θ)) ⟨ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.sizeInput n, [], [], List.ofFn ω⟩ = G) =
        (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.sampleLaw θ n (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.binaryGeometry (ExpandingCodes.PolynomialStretch.dimension θ) n) G).toReal

sources.description: Explicit table layout and data semantics; runtime claims separately open

proof_route: Split the actual fair bits into coefficient, hash and unused blocks. Compose finite bijections to canonical Forms/Hashes, prove decoded entries equal the physical random reader values, and prove finite-index matrix evaluation equals combined under the fixed binary geometry. Push uniform probability through these bijections.

review.notes: Discharges the exact distribution clause for the actual data function, including arbitrary unused suffix, without claiming source execution or polynomial runtime.
